name: Nondescript Letter
summary: Calvin Montague sends a Nondescript Letter from Deathknell to Innkeeper Renee in Brill. He asks newly awakened Forsaken to carry it east, giving them reason to leave the valley for the Gallows' End Tavern.

sections.title: A Courier's Errand
sections.body: Near Deathknell, Calvin Montague asks newly arisen Forsaken to carry an unmarked envelope east to Brill. He says he is weary from fighting zombies and spiders, and that the letter is for Innkeeper Renee. His promise of rich compensation rings hollow. The errand leads travelers out of the valley toward the Gallows' End Tavern.

sections.title: Suspicious Correspondence
sections.body: In Brill, Innkeeper Renee claims the letter brings sweet news from her saintly mother in Deathknell. When the courier sees through her story, her cheerful manner turns to irritation. She snatches the letter and refuses to say who sent it or what it contains. Unless the bearer means to pay for a room, she orders them away.

faq.answer: The Nondescript Letter is an unmarked envelope Calvin Montague gives newly awakened Forsaken near Deathknell to carry to Innkeeper Renee in Brill.

faq.q: Who sends the letter, and who receives it?
faq.answer: Calvin Montague gives the letter to couriers in Deathknell. It is addressed to Innkeeper Renee at the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill.

faq.q: What does the letter actually say?
faq.answer: The letter's contents are never revealed. When you ask, Innkeeper Renee drops her cheerful act and angrily says its origins and contents are none of your business.

faq.q: Why does Calvin Montague want it delivered?
faq.answer: Calvin says he is too busy fighting zombies and spiders nearby to carry the letter himself. The delivery takes travelers out of Deathknell and brings them to Brill's inns and resting places.

angles.text: As a rogue, Calvin Montague's shifty manner and Renee's sudden change of mood suggest intrigue and coded underworld messages.
As a newly risen Forsaken, carrying this letter gives you an early reason to leave Deathknell and explore Tirisfal Glades' settlements.
